decision: Drop of 3 Grid Positions. 2 penalty point (total of 8 for the 12 months period).
event_name: Date 09 September 2022 Time 19:00 2022 ITALIAN GRAND PRIX 08 - 11 September 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (Document 24) and heard from the driver and team representative, have considered the following matter and determine
fact: Car 22 failed to slow under yellow flags after Turn 5.
offence: Breach of Appendix H, Article 2.5.5.b) of the International Sporting Code and noncompliance with Race Director's Event Notes 3.2.
penalty: Drop of 3 Grid Positions. 2 penalty point (total of 8 for the 12 months period).
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 22 (Yuki Tsunoda), the team representative and have reviewed video, marshalling system and telemetry evidence. It was clear that the driver did not reduce speed as required.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 22 Failing To Slow Under Yellow Flags
